info.name: HW4 Task Tracker API (JWT)
info.description: Users, Profiles, Projects, Tasks and Tags with JWT auth. GET endpoints are public; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE need a Bearer token. Run top to bottom: signup/login store tokens in collection variables (collection-level auth = Bearer {{accessToken}}).

item.name: Refresh - access token instead of refresh (401)
Delete task - assignee is not owner (403)
